subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: the buildability lens flags a harness section a worker could not build from — an element of FR-19 unanswered, or answered only by naming a library or tool — and a scenario that cannot be built against the harness as specified
intent: a corpus of e2e design docs with seeded harness holes (an unanswered element, a library-name-only section, a scenario naming a seam the harness does not carry, a scenario with no owned artifact) plus complete controls
fit_criterion: every seeded harness hole flagged; zero buildability findings on the complete controls
